svg.aria-label: A terminal running claude-auto-window --status three times along one clock. First the five-hour window is open at 34 percent, with its reset time and a balance gate that says it would fire a starter on the haiku model. Two and a half hours later the same window has lapsed — open reads no, and that is the moment the daemon wakes. A minute after that a starter has fired: a fresh window is open at 1 percent, resetting five hours out.
